videos.title: YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists or channels
videos.description: One per line: video, Shorts or youtu.be links, 11-character video IDs, playlist URLs, or channel URLs/@handles (add /shorts or /streams for those tabs). Channels return newest videos first.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "transcripts" downloads transcripts. "listCaptionTracks" is free: it returns each video's caption languages and track types (creator or auto-generated) and which track a transcript run would return, without downloading or charging a transcript. Up to 1,000 videos per run. Example: "listCaptionTracks"

searchQueries.title: YouTube search terms
searchQueries.description: Optional. Each term is searched on YouTube and its top videos are transcribed (up to "Max videos per source").

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per source
maxVideosPerSource.description: Cap per playlist, channel tab or search term (newest first for channels). 0 = all. Single video links are always included.

maxVideos.title: Max videos in total
maxVideos.description: Overall cap across all sources. 0 = no cap.

publishedAfter.title: Published on or after
publishedAfter.description: Only videos published on/after this date: YYYY-MM-DD or relative like "30 days". Uses exact upload dates.

publishedBefore.title: Published on or before
publishedBefore.description: Only videos published on/before this date: YYYY-MM-DD or relative like "7 days".

onlyNewVideos.title: Only new videos (incremental monitoring)
onlyNewVideos.description: Skip videos this monitor already delivered in earlier runs (not charged). Schedule the run daily to track competitor channels.

monitorId.title: Monitor name
monitorId.description: Optional name for the incremental-monitoring memory, e.g. "competitors-tech". Defaults to the list of sources.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Caption languages in order of preference (ISO codes, e.g. en, es, pt-BR). The first one available is returned. Regional variants count: "en" also matches en-GB and en-US, and a human-made track in any variant is used before an auto-generated one.

captionType.title: Caption type
captionType.description: Which caption tracks may be used. Every result says whether it is auto-generated.

preferManual.title: Prefer human-made captions
preferManual.description: When both exist in a language (including regional variants such as en-GB / en-US), use the human-made track.

translateTo.title: Translate to (YouTube auto-translate)
translateTo.description: Optional ISO code, best effort. If none of the preferred languages exists, ask YouTube for its machine translation. YouTube often refuses these requests from servers; then the original captions are returned with a warning (or TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE if fallback is off). Never charged when it fails.

fallbackToAnyLanguage.title: Fall back to the video's original language
fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: If no preferred language (or translation) exists, return the video's original spoken language (human-made track if there is one), or the best available track, instead of failing. The result then has requestedLanguageFound=false, languageFallback ("originalLanguage" or "anyLanguage") and a warning.

outputFormats.title: Transcript formats
outputFormats.description: One or more formats per transcript. All formats cost the same. "LLM-ready text" adds llmText: the same words with sound cues ([Music], [Applause], (laughs)), music notes and >> speaker markers removed; the raw text field is unchanged. "Markdown" adds a markdown field per video and one combined TRANSCRIPTS.md file in the key-value store.

punctuate.title: Restore punctuation on unpunctuated auto-captions
punctuate.description: Some YouTube auto-generated captions come as one long lowercase stream with no punctuation. When enabled, those tracks get sentence punctuation (. , ?) and capitalization restored by a built-in model, returned as punctuatedText (and punctuatedSegments). The raw text and segments are never changed. Human-made captions and auto-captions YouTube already punctuated are left as they are. No extra charge. Supported: English and 44 other space-separated languages (not Japanese/Chinese).

includeMetadata.title: Video metadata
includeMetadata.description: Title, channel, duration, views, tags, thumbnail.

includeDetails.title: Publish date, likes, comments and subscribers
includeDetails.description: Adds publishDate, likeCount, commentCount and the channel's subscriberCount (one extra request per video, no extra charge). YouTube rounds comment counts above 1,000 and subscriber counts (e.g. 2.4M), so those are approximate. Turned on automatically when you use a date filter.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave empty for automatic mode: the Actor starts without a proxy and, if YouTube blocks it, switches to Apify datacenter and then residential proxy at no extra cost to you. Set your own proxy here to override.

disableAutoProxy.title: Disable automatic proxy escalation
disableAutoProxy.description: Only for debugging: never switch to a proxy automatically.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries with backoff (and a fresh proxy session) after rate limits or network errors.
